subtheme: Mathematical foundations and new generation methods

subsubthemes.name: Making diffusion models faster and simpler
subsubthemes.gist: These papers find ways to generate images, text, and video in fewer steps or with simpler math, cutting the computational cost of diffusion while keeping quality high.

subsubthemes.name: Improving the math underlying diffusion
subsubthemes.gist: These papers refine the mathematical theory of diffusion—score matching, optimal transport, flow matching—to make training more stable and reasoning about generation more rigorous.

subsubthemes.name: Controlling what the model generates
subsubthemes.gist: These papers add new ways to steer generation toward desired outputs: guidance signals, preference optimization, constraints, and real-time control.

subsubthemes.name: Generating different types of data
subsubthemes.gist: These papers extend diffusion to new modalities—discrete data like text and graphs, videos, audio, proteins, and 3D geometry—each requiring specialized techniques.

subsubthemes.name: Fixing problems in diffusion training and generation
subsubthemes.gist: These papers address unwanted behaviors: memorization, mode collapse, layout bias, and unreliable decoding, and propose fixes to make diffusion models more trustworthy.

subsubthemes.name: Using diffusion for specific tasks
subsubthemes.gist: These papers apply diffusion to solve real problems: restoring and editing images, inverse problems like decompression, and generating specialized outputs like avatars and handwriting.
